eyebrow.zh: 中文 · 省token · 按模型实测
eyebrow.en: Chinese · Save tokens · Measured per model

headline.zh:
一句中文 prompt
按模型量出能省多少 token
headline.en:
One Chinese prompt
the real savings, measured per model

sub.zh: 同一句中文在三个模型上 token 数差 >5%。wenyan 用每个模型自己的计数方式量出真实开销与净省——不是估算，是实测。v0.3.0 起，某个模型暂时连不上，不再整条崩掉：标一行「不可用」，把剩下的照常量完。
sub.en: The same Chinese prompt costs >5% different tokens per model. wenyan counts the real cost on each model's own terms, then the net savings — not an estimate, a measurement. As of v0.3.0: if one model is temporarily unreachable, the run no longer crashes — it marks one row 'unavailable' and finishes the rest.

hero.command: git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/wenyan && cd wenyan && uv pip install -e .

title.zh: 同一句中文，三个模型 token 数差 >5%
title.en: Same Chinese line, >5% token gap across three models

body.zh: 中文 prompt 在不同模型上 token 数不同——有的切得碎，有的切得密。wenyan 一条命令量出来，换模型到底差多少，一眼可见。
body.en: Chinese prompts cost different tokens per model — some split finer, some denser. One command measures the gap, so switching models shows its real price at a glance.

title.zh: 压缩一句中文，每模型净省 token — 不删字、不伤意
title.en: Compress one Chinese line, net savings per model — no deleted characters, no broken meaning

body.zh: 压缩后比压缩前净省多少 token，按模型量出来——每个模型都量成正向。v0.4.0 起，助词剥离只删真正的虚词，不再误删 过滤/哈希/地址 里的字，净省是省字不省义的实测。
body.en: How many tokens the rewrite actually saves, per model — measured net-positive on every model. As of v0.4.0, particle-stripping removes only real particles, no longer deleting characters from words like 过滤/哈希/地址 — the savings are compression, not content loss.

title.zh: 装进 Skill，Agent 直接套用
title.en: Drop in the Skill, your agent applies it

body.zh: 一份 markdown Skill 放进你的编码 Agent，它就按实测套用中文压缩。不用改工作流，不用起服务。
body.en: One markdown Skill into your coding agent and it applies the measured Chinese compression. No workflow change, no server to run.

title.zh: 断网重跑，不再整条崩掉

body.zh: 重跑净省校验时，某个模型暂时连不上（离线、断网、来源被挪走），不再崩出报错整条挂掉——标一行「不可用」，把剩下能连的模型照常量完，干净退出。
body.en: When you re-run the net-savings check and one model is temporarily unreachable (offline, no network, source moved), it no longer crashes the whole run with a traceback — it marks one row 'unavailable', finishes measuring the models it can still reach, and exits clean.

headline.zh: 一句中文，量出能省多少

sub.zh: 一条命令，三个模型的 token 实测 + 净省。
sub.en: One command, three models' real tokens + net savings.
